title: docs(skills): the formula skill names action visible / disabled as the sparse, client-side exception to the total-record rule
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29094
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:formula 技能「`has()` is NOT a null check」一节把「每个谓词读到的 record 对已声明字段全量」限定为服务端求值面(校验规则、`requiredWhen`、option `visibleWhen`、`readonlyWhen`、hook `condition`、flow 触发记录),那里 `!= null` 就是全部守卫;新增一段「动作 `visible` / `disabled` 例外」:它们在客户端绑定已取到的行,列表行可能缺键,守卫照抄 `declared-fields.ts` 的规范写法。Surfaces 表补上 `Action.visible`,标为客户端、稀疏。教程页 Resolve 动作的注释改为指向 `declared-fields.ts` 的规则。
- 为什么改:旧句子让 AI 以为列表行按钮的 `has()` 守卫没用而删掉它,结果列不在视图投影里时谓词报错、按钮静默消失。裁决(6579342813,「同意」选项 A)定了 `declared-fields.ts` 是正确一方。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、一行文档注释和 changeset,无代码;技能 +16 行、+234 token,仍在上限内(5920/5997),上限未动。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 第 124-136 行的例外段;② 同文件第 98-104 行改窄的那句;③ 第 426 行 Surfaces 表的 `Action` 行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期全绿,`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 为 5920/5997。
- 需要你做的:完成 Fable 全量复审后审批并合并本 PR(Tier H `skills/**`)。

## What changes

Text only, inside the claim's file surface. The binding ruling is comment 6579342813 (option A); the guard spellings are copied from the CANONICAL rule in `packages/objectql/src/declared-fields.ts` (lines 28-135 on this head).

- `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, section "`has()` is NOT a null check":
  1. "Every predicate reads a `record` … total over the object's declared fields" now reads "Every server-evaluated predicate — validation rules, `requiredWhen`, option `visibleWhen`, `readonlyWhen`, hook `condition`, the flow trigger record — …", and says `!= null` is the whole guard there. The list is the one in the `declared-fields.ts` header (lines 6-13).
  2. New paragraph: action `visible` / `disabled` are client-side and sparse. They bind the row the client already holds, and a `list_item` row lacks a key when the column is outside the view's projection, when field-level security refuses it, or when it was never written (the mongo and memory drivers). Reading an absent key faults `No such key` and the action silently vanishes. The guard is `has(record.x) && record.x != null`; `has()` alone is enough beside a literal `==` / `!=`; a nested path takes one `has()` per segment. Three example lines follow, each shaped as a row of the canonical tables.
  3. The Surfaces table row `Action | disabled` is now `Action | visible / disabled — client-side, sparse`.
  4. `record.?x.orValue(…)` is not taught.
- `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`: only the comment above the Resolve action's `visible` changed. It now points at the rule in `packages/objectql/src/declared-fields.ts` and no longer restates it. The guard itself is unchanged.
- `.changeset/29094-formula-skill-action-sparse.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch. The skills bundle publishes: `packages/skills` ships `dist`, synced from `skills/**` by `scripts/sync-catalog.mjs`, so a `skills/**` text change owes a patch changeset.

The other seven places that state the sparse rule (`declared-fields.ts`, the `validate-null-guards.ts` ledger, `predicate-matrix.action.ts`, the CRM action and its test, `quick-start.mdx`, `protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`, `ui/actions.mdx`) are untouched.

No ceiling moved and no line was re-wrapped. The addition is the ruling's four points; nothing else in the skill was rewritten.

## Tests

No code changed, so no unit test applies. The gates below are the evidence.

## Acceptance notes

- No eval was added. The repo owes a skill eval for a protocol addition; this change is `Metadata-protocol: none`, and evals for `skills/objectstack-*` have no mechanical requirement (`check:skill-eval-tokens` covers `ui/skills` only). The seat may still want one; see the report.
- Eval 5 of `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` teaches `has(record.discount)` as always true for a field `visibleWhen`. A field `visibleWhen` is not on the ruling's server-evaluated list and not on the action surface, so this PR leaves it as is. Noted, not filed.
- `origin/main` was merged once (at `d93acbbe55`) before this PR was opened. `main` has moved since; `dispatch-gates` reports none of the newer commits touch this card's gate inputs.
